hypothesis: Reusing IQ2_S weight-block dequantization across multiple token rows speeds up CPU MoE prefill while leaving single-token decode unchanged.
workload: Qwen3.8 Flash Next UD-IQ3_XXS with MTP draft, 64K context, 12 CPU threads, EHS off, CPU MoE and CPU embedding overrides; one fixed 395-token prompt plus deterministic 16-token completion.

stability.first_candidate_attempt: three matching responses followed by CUDA graph instantiation OOM on request four
stability.retry: five of five requests completed without an OOM
stability.decision: The retry is numerically stable, but the speed signal is negative and below noise; the initial OOM prevents accepting the implementation as a runtime change.

decision_note: Do not merge. The direct fused AVX2 implementation adds register pressure and loses about 1.1% on the actual 395-token prefill workload. Retain only the isolated worktree for future analysis.
